A total of 4,768 resonances were detected in 479 plasma discharges during the 2019-2020 JET deuterium campaign.
The measured resonant frequencies showed good agreement with the estimated Toroidal Alfvén Eigenmode (TAE) frequencies, with the histogram peaking at a ratio of f0/fTAE = 1.2.
The recently upgraded independent phasing of the eight AEAD antennas allowed probing of high toroidal mode numbers up to |n| ≤ 20.
The probability of resonance detection decreased with increasing plasma current and external heating power.
The normalized damping rate (-γ/ω0) increased with edge safety factor but decreased with external heating.
A correction was applied to the damping rates to account for the effects of changing antenna and resonant frequencies.
The 5th to 95th percentile ranges of plasma parameters were: Ip = 1.7-3.6 MA, B0 = 2.4-3.4 T, ne0 = 3.2-7.9 × 10^19 m^-3, and q95 = 3.0-5.6.

The toroidal mode numbers were estimated using two methods: a weighted chi-square calculation using probe phase information, and the SparSpec algorithm which decomposes both probe amplitude and phase data.
There was generally good agreement between the toroidal mode numbers applied by the AEAD and those estimated for the excited resonances.
Approximately 83% of the resonances were measured in X-point magnetic configurations, with the remaining 17% in limiter configurations.
The AEAD was operated during 676 plasma discharges during the 2019-2020 deuterium campaign, spanning JPN 93063-96855.
The AEAD antennas were operated most frequently with phases corresponding to toroidal mode numbers n = 0, -1, -4, and -10.
The magnetic signals from the fourteen fast magnetic probes were synchronously detected at the antenna frequency with an effective band-pass filter width of Δf ≈ 0.1 kHz.
The final fitted values of resonant frequency f0 and damping rate γ/ω0 were calculated as the weighted mean of all probes' fits, with the standard error used for the total uncertainty.
Resonances with uncertainties Δf0 > 1 kHz, Δ(γ/ω0) > 1%, or R-squared < 0.8 were discarded from the final database.
